text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Wakagoma Stakes has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the race, Tokai Teio enters Nice Nature's waiting room by mistake and preemptively declares victory with great confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature, who has hardly even been acknowledged by Tokai Teio, is determined to give her a challenge as she heads to the racecourse.
